utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, I appreciate it. I’m keeping the porch schedule open, so send anyone handy my way for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Tess. I’ll keep asking around and send anyone handy your way for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few more helpers. I’ll send anyone handy your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. I’m free to help this Saturday on the front porch, and I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. I’m still sorting the logistics for Saturday, so having you line up a few neighbors helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll reach out to a few neighbors and confirm who can help on Saturday. I’ll also make sure we have the basics covered for the front porch setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday, and what help do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 10 a.m. would be great, and I could use someone steady with tools, plus a hand sorting parts and greeting folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia. If you can point a few handy folks my way, I’ll make sure they know to come by the front porch at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way. I’m just trying to make sure the timing and supply setup are clear so nobody shows up confused.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I’ll be there around 10 on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Oren, that helps a lot. I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, so I’ll put you to work when you get here around 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam. Could you be there at 9 a.m. so we can get everything set up before people arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ll be there at 9 a.m. and help get everything set up.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
